blocks.html: Sweet days and stylish stay are what await lovebirds and families at Summit Hotels as they offer great deals this love month.

Checkout Summit Hotel Greenhills located along Annapolis, Greenhills, San Juan. Dine in style at the hotel’s all-day-dining restaurant Café Summit and enjoy the delightful and specially crafted Valentine’s menu prepared by Chef Daniel Lachica on February 14. Savor this 6-course meal with cocktail of choice for only Php800 nett per person. Better yet, book and relax in the hotel’selegant interiors and spacious accommodations for only Php3,088 nett per night which already includes asumptuousbreakfast for you and your family plus, a generous serving of chocolate welcome treats! Enjoy your staycation further with a refreshing swim at the indoor pooloverlooking the city skyline and taking an energizing workout at the hotel’s 24/7 fitness gym. Enjoy this perk until April 6, 2020.

If heading out of town, spend your Valentine’s weekend at Summit Ridge Tagaytay. Feast on its Valentine’sDay menu specials ranging from seared salmon with port reduction to mouthwatering molten chocolate cake with vanilla cream. What’s more, get yourself a Summit Suite and stay in bed all day- all cuddled-up with your lovey amidst the cool weather! Love month rates starts at Php5,600per night to Php6,700++ per night inclusive of breakfast and in-room chocolate freebies!
For reservations and inquiries, email reservations@summithotels.ph; or call (02) 8 3988788 for Summit Hotel Greenhills and (02) 8 2406831for Summit Ridge Tagytay; orcontact 09988887788.
